newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust enters Chilean alliance.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust enters Chilean alliance.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp said on Thursday that it has entered a strategic alliance for Cruz Blanca Prevision y Seguros SA and Banmedica SA to invest in its Chilean insurance and annuity business.
Each of the purchasers will pay Bankers Trust US$109 million for 25 percent stakes in Consorcio Nacional de Seguros SA, Bankers Trust said.
Bankers Trust will hold 50 percent of the company after the separate transactions.
A Bankers Trust spokesman said this deal will enable it to expand its Latin American insurance and annuity operations.
Consorcio Nacional de Seguros, Chile's largest insurance and annuities firm, has benefitted from the company's privatized pension system, the spokesman said.
